essence: Piercing bamboo is accomplished immediately and without doubt.
One should offer mercury mixed with arka milk in the fire.
Sesame smeared with ghee and dūrvā grass sprinkled with ghee should be used for oblation.
Purification of abdominal diseases is effected with pathya and peppers.
Eye diseases and similar ailments are treated with milk and ghee.
